title: Circuit breaker protects downstream LLM endpoints from cascading failure

test_cases.name: Trips CLOSED -> OPEN at failure threshold
test_cases.expected_result: State becomes OPEN and check_state raises CircuitBreakerOpenException
test_cases.evidence: Circuit tripped to OPEN and immediately rejected subsequent call

test_cases.name: Transitions OPEN -> HALF_OPEN after recovery timeout
test_cases.expected_result: Circuit transitions to HALF_OPEN to permit probe execution
test_cases.evidence: Circuit transitioned OPEN -> HALF_OPEN after recovery timeout elapsed

test_cases.name: Closes circuit on probe success in HALF_OPEN
test_cases.evidence: Trial success closed the circuit breaker

test_cases.name: Re-trips to OPEN on probe failure
test_cases.expected_result: Circuit immediately returns to OPEN state
test_cases.evidence: Probe failure in HALF_OPEN immediately returned circuit to OPEN

test_cases.name: Circuit breaker stats tracking
test_cases.evidence: Circuit breaker stats reflect failure count and state
